name: Sethir's Journal
summary: On Teldrassil, Sethir's Journal was recovered through stealth. Its pages confirm that corruption from mainland Kalimdor has reached the World Tree.

sections.title: A Clue to the Taint
sections.body: Teldrassil was raised in the hope of reclaiming elven immortality, yet an unseen sickness has taken root across its boughs. In Darnassus, Syurna suspected that Sethir the Ancient held answers. The solitary satyr lurks on an outlying branch near the Oracle Glade. Past scouts who tried diplomacy or open force met only death, so stealthy pickpocketing yielded Sethir's journal. Its writings reveal that the mysterious blight poisoning the woods and waters across the sea in Darkshore has crossed into Teldrassil itself.

faq.answer: Sethir's Journal is carried by Sethir the Ancient, a hostile satyr living along the outer branches near the Oracle Glade on Teldrassil. Its notes detail the corruption spreading through the region.

aliases: how do i get sethirs journal
faq.answer: Past attempts to bargain with or fight Sethir ended in failure and death. The journal must be lifted from his packs through stealth.
Rogue trainer Syurna says the journal proves that the strange sickness blighting Darkshore's forests and waters has reached Teldrassil.

Sethir the Ancient is a solitary satyr on a secluded branch along the outskirts of the Oracle Glade. He deals violently with interlopers and holds information on the corruption creeping across the World Tree.

angles.text: As a Rogue, you can use stealth and pickpocketing to uncover vital intelligence where warriors and diplomats failed.
As a Night Elf, you face evidence that Teldrassil is not immune to the ancient demonic taint creeping across mainland Kalimdor.
